using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenRelinquishOwnershipFails()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup to simulate successful migration steps before relinquish ownership failure
            migrateSession.SetupTrySetSlotRangesAsync(true);
            migrateSession.SetupTryPrepareLocalForMigration(true);
            migrateSession.SetupBumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsync(true);
            migrateSession.SetupReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync(true);
            migrateSession.SetupMigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync(true);
            migrateSession.SetupTrySetSlotRangesAsync(true);
            migrateSession.SetupRelinquishOwnership(false); // This triggers the error log on line 206

            // Act
            await migrateSession.InvokeBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed to relinquish ownership from source node")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.Equal(MigrateState.FAIL, migrateSession.Status);
        }

        // Helper subclass to expose private method and override dependencies
        private class TestableMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;

            public TestableMigrateSession(ILogger logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                base.logger = logger;
            }

            public MigrateState Status => base.Status;

            public void SetupTrySetSlotRangesAsync(bool result)
            {
                _trySetSlotRangesResult = result;
            }

            public void SetupTryPrepareLocalForMigration(bool result)
            {
                _tryPrepareLocalForMigrationResult = result;
            }

            public void SetupBumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsync(bool result)
            {
                _bumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionResult = result;
            }

            public void SetupReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync(bool result)
            {
                _reserveDestinationVectorSetsResult = result;
            }

            public void SetupMigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync(bool result)
            {
                _migrateSlotsDriverInlineResult = result;
            }

            public void SetupRelinquishOwnership(bool result)
            {
                _relinquishOwnershipResult = result;
            }

            public async Task InvokeBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync()
            {
                await base.BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();
            }

            // Override methods to simulate behavior
            protected override Task<bool> TrySetSlotRangesAsync(string nodeid, MigrateState state)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_trySetSlotRangesResult);
            }

            protected override bool TryPrepareLocalForMigration()
            {
                return _tryPrepareLocalForMigrationResult;
            }

            protected override Task<bool> ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_reserveDestinationVectorSetsResult);
            }

            protected override Task<bool> MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_migrateSlotsDriverInlineResult);
            }

            protected override bool RelinquishOwnership()
            {
                return _relinquishOwnershipResult;
            }

            protected override Task<bool> BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_bumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionResult);
            }

            // Fields to control behavior
            private bool _trySetSlotRangesResult = true;
            private bool _tryPrepareLocalForMigrationResult = true;
            private bool _bumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionResult = true;
            private bool _reserveDestinationVectorSetsResult = true;
            private bool _migrateSlotsDriverInlineResult = true;
            private bool _relinquishOwnershipResult = true;
        }
    }
}

The MigrateSession class and MigrateState enum are internal, so they are inaccessible from the test project. To write tests that cover the ILogger.LogError call on line 206, we need to make the BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync method accessible for testing.

I will apply the `make_virtual` refactor to the `BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync` method to allow subclassing and overriding it in a test subclass. This will let us simulate the failure scenario and verify the logger call.

<tool>apply_refactor(transform=make_virtual, method=BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync)</tool>

The production code is internal and sealed, and the refactor tool is not available to make the method virtual or expose it for testing. This prevents direct subclassing or mocking to simulate the failure scenario that triggers the LogError call on line 206.

Given these constraints, writing a direct unit test for that exact line is not feasible without modifying the production code to add test seams.

If you want, I can help write integration-style tests that exercise the public API and indirectly cover the error logging, or help with other testing tasks. Let me know how you would like to proceed.
